TUNESTRAIN-TUNE_STRAIN_BIAS_POWER.title: Tune Strain · Bias
TUNESTRAIN-TUNE_STRAIN_BIAS_POWER.descri: When Resonance Break triggers, this is converted into [gold]Tune Strain · Interference[/gold]. At 3 or more stacks, this Resonance Break's own damage also gains the Tune Strain damage bonus.
TUNESTRAIN-TUNE_STRAIN_BIAS_POWER.smartD: When Resonance Break triggers, this is converted into Tune Strain · Interference. At 3 or more stacks, this Resonance Break's own damage also gains the Tune Strain damage bonus.
TUNESTRAIN-TUNE_STRAIN_INTERFERENCE_POWE: Increases direct damage players deal to this monster. Only Resonance Break triggered with at least 3 Tune Strain · Bias stacks also gains the Tune Strain bonus to its own damage. Other Resonance Breaks, Fusion Burst detonations and Melt are unaffected. The higher the Tune Strain · Interference and Tune Strain Response stacks are, the larger the damage bonus. Lasts 3 turns; when Tune Strain Resonance Break triggers again, the stacks become the higher of the old and new values and the duration resets to 3 turns.

TUNESTRAIN-TUNE_STRAIN_RESPONSE_POWER.de: When Tune Strain Resonance Break triggers, count cards with [gold]Tune Strain Response[/gold] in your draw pile, discard pile, and hand. Keep the higher of this count and your current stacks. Higher stacks increase the damage bonus from [gold]Tune Strain · Interference[/gold]. Lasts 3 turns. Triggering Tune Strain Resonance Break again resets the duration to 3 turns.
